# The QML type the panel instantiates. In-process on purpose: no daemon, no bus, no listener.
# The plugin class is generated by qt_add_qml_module - do not hand-write one, it will collide.

# Set the QML source directory
set(QML_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../qml")

# Collect all QML files
set(QML_FILES
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/MindDock.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/MindTabBar.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/MindTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/tabs/DashboardTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/tabs/IdentityTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/tabs/IntentionsTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/tabs/ActivityTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/tabs/SelfTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/tabs/PredictorTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/tabs/WorkspaceTab.qml
    ${QML_SOURCE_DIR}/utils/StatCard.qml
)

qt_add_qml_module(cybou-presence-qml
    URI org.cybou.presence
    VERSION 1.0
    PLUGIN_TARGET cybou-presence-qml
    NO_PLUGIN_OPTIONAL
    SOURCES
        QmlTypes.cpp
        QmlTypes.h
    QML_FILES
        ${QML_FILES}
)

target_link_libraries(cybou-presence-qml PRIVATE Qt6::Qml cybou-presence)

# Installed only when a destination is given, so a plain developer build stays in the build
# tree and never writes outside it.
if(DEFINED CYBOU_QML_INSTALL_DIR)
    set(_dest "${CYBOU_QML_INSTALL_DIR}/org/cybou/presence")
    install(TARGETS cybou-presence-qml LIBRARY DESTINATION "${_dest}")
    install(FILES
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qmldir"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cybou-presence-qml.qmltypes"
        DESTINATION "${_dest}"
    )
endif()
